blocks.text: Electronic configuration dikhane ka ek achha tareeqa woh diagram hai jis mein electrons boxes (khaanon) mein rakhe jate hain (Figure 2.13).

items: Har box ek atomic orbital hai.
Boxes (orbitals) neeche se oopar barhti energy ki tarteeb mein rakhe jate hain.
Electron ek teer (arrow) se dikhaya jata hai.

blocks.text: Teer ki direction electron ka ‘spin’ batati hai.
Jab ek orbital mein do electrons hon to un ke spins ulte hote hain, is liye us box ke do teer ulti taraf hote hain (↑↓).

blocks.alt: Boxes mein boron, neeche se oopar: 1s mein ulte teeron ka joRa, 2s mein ulte teeron ka joRa, aur 2p ke teen khane jin mein pehle mein ek oopar wala teer aur baqi do khaali.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.13: Boxes mein boron ki electronic configuration (kitab ki Figure 2.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Boron (5 electrons): sab se neeche 1s mein ↑↓, us ke oopar 2s mein ↑↓, aur sab se oopar 2p ke teen boxes mein se pehle mein ek ↑; baqi do khaali.

Ek hi jagah ke electrons ek doosre ko dhakelte (repel) hain kyun ke un ka charge ek jaisa (negative) hai. Is liye jahan mumkin ho, electrons ek subshell ke alag alag orbitals mein baithte hain taa ke dhakel (repulsion) kam ho. Alag orbitals mein in electrons ke spins same hote hain. Jora (pair) sirf tab banta hai jab subshell mein koi khaali orbital na bache.
Figure 2.14 carbon, nitrogen aur oxygen ki electronic structures dikha kar yeh baat samjhati hai.

blocks.alt: Carbon (1s2 2s2 2p2), nitrogen (1s2 2s2 2p3) aur oxygen (1s2 2s2 2p4) ke box diagrams. Carbon ke teen 2p boxes mein se do mein aik aik teer, nitrogen ke teeno mein aik aik, aur oxygen ke 2px mein joray aur 2py aur 2pz mein aik aik: electrons tab hi joray bante hain jab har orbital mein pehle se aik ho.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.14: Kisi subshell mein electrons dalte hue jora tab hi banta hai jab koi khaali orbital na bache (kitab ki Figure 2.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Carbon (2p²): do alag boxes mein ek ek ↑. Nitrogen (2p³): teeno boxes mein ek ek ↑. Oxygen (2p⁴): ab koi box khaali nahi, is liye chautha electron 2px mein ↓ ban kar jora banata hai.
Upar ke principles ke mutabiq kuch elements ki electronic configurations Table 2.7 mein hain.

blocks.caption: Table 2.7 Elements Z = 1 se 36 ki ground state electronic configurations

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Z = 19 se aage har configuration 1s²2s²2p⁶3s²3p⁶ (argon jaisi) se shuru hoti hai; isay mukhtasar [Ar] likh sakte hain, maslan K = [Ar] 4s¹. Chromium (3d⁵4s¹) aur copper (3d¹⁰4s¹) ko dhyan se dekhein: aadha bhara ya poora bhara d subshell zyada stable hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Phosphorus (Z = 15) ke valence electrons ka box diagram alfaaz mein likhein, Hund ke rule aur Pauli ke principle ke mutabiq.
blocks.explanation: Phosphorus: 1s²2s²2p⁶3s²3p³. Valence electrons: 3s box mein ↑↓, aur teen 3p boxes (px, py, pz) mein ek ek ↑, yani teen unpaired electrons same spin ke saath.

items: Box diagram: har orbital ek box, energy neeche se oopar, spin teer se, jore mein ulte teer.
Electrons pehle alag orbitals mein (same spin), phir jora: C do akele, N teen akele, O ek jora.
Table 2.7: Z = 1 se 36; 4s, 3d se pehle bharta hai; Cr 3d⁵4s¹ aur Cu 3d¹⁰4s¹.
